#{item.registBankCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} REGIST_BANK_CODE, #{item.indentifyMark, jdbcType=VARCHAR} INDENTIFY_MARK, #{item.mergerindentifymark, jdbcType=VARCHAR} MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK, #{item.ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CCY, #{item.holdDate,jdbcType=DATE} HOLD_DATE, #{item.prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} PRODID, #{item.operatestatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OPERATE_STATUS, #{item.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} STATUS
) tmp INNER JOIN
CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB sub on tmp.REGIST_BANK_CODE = sub.REGIST_BANK_CODE and tmp.INDENTIFY_MARK = sub.INDENTIFY_MARK and tmp.HOLD_DATE = sub.HOLD_DATE and tmp.CCY = sub.CCY and tmp.PRODID = sub.PRODID and sub.SEND_STATUS = '01' where not exists( select 1 from CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_CHECK infocheck where infocheck.INDENTIFY_MARK = tmp.INDENTIFY_MARK and infocheck.REGIST_BANK_CODE = tmp.REGIST_BANK_CODE and infocheck.CCY = tmp.CCY and infocheck.PRODID = tmp.PRODID and infocheck.HOLD_DATE = tmp.HOLD_DATE )

SELECT sub.REGIST_BANK_CODE, sub.INDENTIFY_MARK, sub.HOLD_DATE, sub.CCY, sub.PRODID, sub.AMOUNT, sub.QTY, sub.CNY_AMT, sub.PRD_REGIST_CODE, sub.REMARK, sub.WORKFLOW_ID, sub.ORG_CODE, sub.DEPT_CODE, sub.UPDATE_USER, sub.UPDATE_TIME, sub.CREATE_USER, sub.CREATE_TIME,sub.CREATE_DEPT, tmp.MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK, tmp.OPERATE_STATUS, tmp.STATUS FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_TMP tmp INNER JOIN CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB sub on tmp.REGIST_BANK_CODE = sub.REGIST_BANK_CODE and tmp.INDENTIFY_MARK = sub.INDENTIFY_MARK and tmp.HOLD_DATE = sub.HOLD_DATE and tmp.CCY = sub.CCY and tmp.PRODID = sub.PRODID and sub.SEND_STATUS = '01' where not exists( select 1 from CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_CHECK infocheck where infocheck.INDENTIFY_MARK = tmp.INDENTIFY_MARK and infocheck.REGIST_BANK_CODE = tmp.REGIST_BANK_CODE and infocheck.CCY = tmp.CCY and infocheck.PRODID = tmp.PRODID and infocheck.HOLD_DATE = tmp.HOLD_DATE )

SELECT tmp.REGIST_BANK_CODE, tmp.CCY, tmp.HOLD_DATE, tmp.PRODID, C.INDENTIFY_MARK, C.MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK, C.OPERATE_STATUS, C.STATUS FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_TMP tmp INNER JOIN CHB_EQU_HOLD_CHECK C on C.MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK = tmp.MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK and C.REGIST_BANK_CODE = tmp.REGIST_BANK_CODE
mapper.delete: delete from CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO info WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_TMP tmp WHERE info.REGIST_BANK_CODE = tmp.REGIST_BANK_CODE AND info.INDENTIFY_MARK = tmp.INDENTIFY_MARK AND info.PRD_REGIST_CODE = tmp.PRD_REGIST_CODE AND info.HOLD_DATE = tmp.HOLD_DATE AND info.CCY = tmp.CCY )

delete from CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB sub WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_TMP tmp WHERE sub.REGIST_BANK_CODE = tmp.REGIST_BANK_CODE AND sub.INDENTIFY_MARK = tmp.INDENTIFY_MARK AND sub.PRD_REGIST_CODE = tmp.PRD_REGIST_CODE AND sub.HOLD_DATE = tmp.HOLD_DATE AND sub.CCY = tmp.CCY AND sub.PRODID = tmp.PRODID AND sub.SEND_STATUS = tmp.SEND_STATUS )
